title: Dual line driver (75109-75110)

sources.document: TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, SN55109/SN55110/SN75109/SN75110 (bulletin DL-S 7111224)

pins.name: 1C
pins.text: inhibitor for channel 1: low turns both outputs of channel 1 off

pins.name: 1Y
pins.text: current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off

pins.name: 1Z
pins.text: current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off

pins.name: 2Y
pins.text: current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off

pins.name: 2Z
pins.text: current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off

functions.formula: Y on (low) = C AND D AND NOT (A AND B); otherwise off (high)
functions.text: Truth table: with both inhibitors high, Y is on when A or B is low; when A and B are both high, Y is off and Z is on.

functions.formula: Z on (low) = C AND D AND A AND B; otherwise off (high)
functions.text: Complementary current output of the same channel. Either inhibitor low turns both Y and Z off.

electrical.notes: VCC+ 4.75-5.25 V, VCC- -4.75 to -5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Current-mode outputs: on-state output current SN75109 min 3.5 mA, max 7 mA (SN75110: 6.5 to 15 mA); off-state current max 100 uA. Common-mode output voltage range 0 to +10 V and 0 to -3 V (recommended). Logic and inhibitor inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V. When one channel is unused, inhibit it and/or ground its outputs.

timing.conditions: VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 50 ohm, CL 40 pF

unknown: IOL/IOH are not meaningful for these current-switch outputs; the datasheet gives on-state current instead (recorded in notes), so both current fields are null.
notes: ND symbol covers 75109 and 75110; they differ only in on-state current (75109 about 6 mA, 75110 about 12 mA typical per page 4-6).
